offline.title: No shared network?
offline.subtitle: Make a direct connection between the two devices — no internet needed.
offline.host_label: On this device — host the connection

manual.generic: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi or hotspot; they will then find each other automatically.

windows.host_1: Open Settings → Network & internet → Mobile hotspot and turn it on.
windows.host_2: Set its network name and password to the ones shown above (or note the ones Windows shows).
windows.host_3: On the other device, join that Wi-Fi network — krokodyl will find it automatically.
windows.join_1: Open the Wi-Fi menu and connect to the host's network name shown above.
windows.join_2: Enter the password above; krokodyl will detect the other device.

linux.host_1: Open your network settings and enable a Wi-Fi hotspot (or run: nmcli device wifi hotspot).
linux.host_2: Use the network name and password shown above.
linux.host_3: On the other device, join that network — krokodyl will find it automatically.
linux.join_1: Open the Wi-Fi menu and connect to the host's network shown above.
linux.join_2: Enter the password above; krokodyl will detect the other device.

darwin.host_1: Open System Settings → General → Sharing → Internet Sharing.
darwin.host_2: Share to Wi-Fi, set the network name and password above, then turn Internet Sharing on.
darwin.host_3: On the other device, join that network — krokodyl will find it automatically.
darwin.join_1: Open the Wi-Fi menu and connect to the host's network shown above.
darwin.join_2: Enter the password above; krokodyl will detect the other device.

offline.load_failed: Could not load the offline connection details.

phone.title: Receive from a phone
phone.subtitle: Scan this code with your phone's camera, or open the address below in its browser. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
phone.same_network: Files you pick on the phone arrive in your downloads folder.
phone.qr_alt: QR code linking to the krokodyl upload page
phone.localsend_note: Also discoverable in the LocalSend app — pick krokodyl there to send without scanning.
